events.title: Better graphics performance
events.summary: I've been working on improving performance and fixing a few graphics issues, especially for players having trouble running Satelital on laptops with integrated GPUs. This update might not be enough to make the game run well for everyone, but it should help. For example, the game can now run at a stable 90 FPS on the Steam Deck OLED. Here is the full list of changes in this build:Fixed a Windows GPU issue that could cause a black screen.Improved rendering performance by skipping unnecessary work

events.title: HDR improvements and fixes
events.summary: This update is mostly about HDR. I received a few reports of HDR not looking right on some displays, so I've spent the last few days refactoring and tweaking the tonemapping to make the colors really pop. HDR should now look much better and work correctly on a much wider range of displays.Here's what's new:Fixed HDR tonemapping for most displays. Previously, it only worked correctly on a limited number of monitors.The HDR toggle now automatically switches your display to HDR mode when available.

events.title: Fixed frame pacing issues
events.summary: Everytime I think I fixed every issue then I find a new one 😅 So here is a few more stuff that got cleaned, most importantly a frame pacing issue that improves performance by 20% (on my laptop) Fixed the cursor light appearing in the wrong position.Fixed the cursor displaying the wrong state in some cases.Fixed lighting on some SDFs caused by incorrectly oriented normals.Improved performance by preparing the next frame while the current one is still drawing. Now frames get presented 20% faster.

events.title: Satelital is Ready for Steam Deck
events.summary: I love playing games on my Steam Deck, so I really wanted Satelital to feel great on it too.I've spent a lot of time optimizing the game for Steam Deck and it runs now at a smooth 90 FPS.The entire game is playable with the built-in controls, including exploring the solar system, navigating menus, and solving puzzles. The UI and text are also designed to work comfortably on the Deck's screen.If you prefer playing on a handheld, I hope you'll give it a try!

events.title: Satelital Demo now available!
events.summary: The demo is now available to everyone on Steam.It includes two complete worlds and around an hour of gameplay. Your save data and achievements will carry over to the full game.I've been working on Satelital for a long time and it's great to finally have the demo out there. Give it a try and let me know what you think!Satelital is coming to Steam on November 13, 2026.

events.title: Satelital Demo Release Date: September 10, 2026
